record.bible_text: <FO><FO>To the chief Musician<WH05329><WTH8764>, A Psalm<WH04210> of David<WH01732>, when Nathan<WH05416> the prophet<WH05030> came<WH0935><WTH8800> unto him, after he had gone in<WH0935><WTH8804> to Bathsheba<WH01339>.<Fo><Fo> Have mercy<WH02603><WTH8798> upon me, O God<WH0430>, according to thy lovingkindness<WH02617>: according unto the multitude<WH07230> of thy tender mercies<WH07356> blot out<WH04229><WTH8798> my transgressions<WH06588>.

Cast me not away<WH07993><WTH8686> from thy presence<WH06440>; and take<WH03947><WTH8799> not thy holy<WH06944> spirit<WH07307> from me.

<FI> Then<Fi> will I teach<WH03925><WTH8762> transgressors<WH06586><WTH8802> thy ways<WH01870>; and sinners<WH02400> shall be converted<WH07725><WTH8799> unto thee.<CM>
